summary: BioVie filed Amendment No. 1 to a prospectus supplement (424B5) under its Form S-3 shelf, cutting the at-the-market offering capacity available under its September 11, 2026 sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners from up to $6,464,341 to up to $1,225,000 of Class A common stock. Sales are made through A.G.P. as agent or principal; no price, premium or closing date is set, and shares trade on Nasdaq under BIVI at $1.73 as of November 3, 2026. The reduction reflects the I.B.6 one-third public-float cap on the $17.9M float. Watch dilution pace and any further ATM resets.
